hero_kpi_rationale: The upstream master KPI, hydrocarbon production is the primary driver of revenues and margins for integrated oil majors. A robust growth trajectory supports capital discipline and shareholder returns.

kpis.explanation_en: Cash generated after deduction of ongoing investments.

kpis.explanation_en: Profitability of invested capital, calculated as net income divided by average capital employed.
kpis.description: Return on capital employed stands at 9.4% in 2025 (9.3% according to Business Profile), down 3.4 percentage points from 12.7% in 2024, reflecting margin compression in a less favorable pricing environment.

kpis.explanation_en: Consolidated net result after income taxes.
kpis.description: Net income amounts to $28.8 billion in 2025, down 14% from $33.7 billion in 2024, reflecting margin compression in the Energy Products and Chemical Products segments.
